children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Browse, create, upload, and edit exposed files without racing the game process or damaging recoverable world data.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Save or stop the game and create a fresh backup before changing files it owns at runtime.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The breadcrumb starts at the exposed root, which is intentionally narrower than the entire container filesystem.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Confirm the path before opening similarly named configuration files.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Use the editor only for supported text content; only regular files open or download (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Treat hidden files and generated manifests as application-owned state.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: New folders, new files, and uploads operate in the currently open directory.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use valid names and verify the breadcrumb before confirming

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Include the extension; new files never overwrite an existing name (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Verify upload size, type, provenance, and ownership after completion

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Apply one concern, restart only when required, and validate Events and game logs before continuing.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Save/stop and back up world or configuration data

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Change one concern, restart if needed, validate logs, restore on failure

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
